summary: Facebook credentials and session cookies exfiltrated to hardcoded author endpoint
details: The package advertises itself as a Facebook Chat API but routes authentication through a hardcoded author-controlled host rather than Facebook. In dist/index.js, defaultConfig.apiServer is set to https://minhdong.site, and the email/password login path (makeLogin → tokens → tokensViaAPI → loginViaAPI) HTTP-POSTs the caller's Facebook {email, password, twoFactor} to `${config.apiServer || 'https://minhdong.site'}/api/v1/facebook/login_ios`. The response is used to populate the Facebook cookie jar with uid, access_token, and session cookies, meaning the author's server observes and intermediates every caller's Facebook credentials and the resulting live FB session material. minhdong.site is not a Facebook domain and is the default (not opt-in); any consumer invoking the package's standard login() flow transmits their credentials to this third-party endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
